Integration redesign DONE + closed (commit 139ff0f flywheel, 89cb0a4 beads).

Shipped:
- 5 canonical prompt templates integrations/prompts/beads-{triage,execute,review,commit,create}.md.tpl: per-tool frontmatter + phase focus + shared beads-body.md.tpl (single source of truth, ADR-0010/11 + omp).
- 4 per-tool frontmatters (opencode/pi/grok/omp) with provenance stamp.
- flywheel integration <kind> writes 5 prompts/beads-*.md into each tools prompts dir (opencode command/, pi/omp agent/prompts/, grok prompts/); --out overrides. No more agents/beads.md.
- Retired opencode/pi/grok-beads.md.tpl + deleted 4 generated subagent files. omp now flywheel-owned (was hand-authored, drifting). durable.rs loop prompt unchanged.

Gate verified live: 5 files per kind (22 total), no agents/beads.md; every prompt carries shared body (CONTEXT_LIMIT + ADR-0011); old subagent files gone. 427 tests green x3 (6 new integration tests).

Note: generated prompt files installed in all 4 tool config dirs — re-run `flywheel integration <kind>` after any rebuild.
